summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, dialogue, avatar presentation, stealth, and quests. Level 1's M.E.G. camp now hosts the Short Rations and Bad Water quest chains, including alternate talk, skill-check, pickpocket, and kill paths and Callum's unique Lucky Thirteen revolver reward.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, and Glow Up Salon styling stations.

places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room systems, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed far-east breach; selected clutter is range-culled.

places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1, Zenith Station: versioned station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, flight-recorder quest, and drones that refill destroyed posts after an hour.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 1's Dina camp and M.E.G. agents Callum, Ortiz, and Ale anchor the new Short Rations and Bad Water quest chains.

places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and climbable library ladders.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11, places/level12, places/level26 (3D) - Lights Out, Thalassophobia, Bumper Crop, Infinite City, Matrix, and SS Fun =) liner; authored place systems include farming, canals, rituals, and large set pieces.
places/debug, places/spamton and other configured places (3D) - debug mannequin/body gallery and switch pad, Spamton's fight space, and auxiliary routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; climb.js runs after swim.js and quest-marker.js is the final player behavior.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main sim owns Level 0 generation and place sims own local layouts/rebuilds/ticks.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene driver, BODIES toggle, and solo-place pause time-scale.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own its route and beats.

places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/dina-diary.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina camp/diary entry sequence; M.E.G. dialogue quests are dispatched separately through talk.js and level1-quests.js.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js - camera and third-person toggle, HUD and panels; scripts/lib/screen.js names the screen state shared by UI and behaviors.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player quest journal, tracking input and world markers; quest-marker also folds legacy quest state into the journal.

places/level12/sim.js + places/level12/cells/*.scene - versioned Matrix room/void construction and shared ticking ritual clock; art/human-base, human-head/face/cloth/hair scripts and tools build/validate avatar assets.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and last-level names including level01 and level12; routing and hub handlers use it.

scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, weapon definitions/rarity and weapon variants reused by search and combat; unique variants are excluded from rolls.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.

scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only screen classifier and wrist gates; scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - shared quest records/tracking and resolving {place,id} or coordinate objectives for the journal, HUD and world markers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/maze0path.js - seeded Level 0 cell/zone/wall/pit/pillar layout and open-point/BFS doorway steering shared by place simulation and smiler/lurker navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + wardrobe.yml + wardrobe-split.yml + critter.yml/faces.yml/hair.yml/critter-models.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - clothing loot/armor, deterministic looks, species/head/hair presentation; wardrobe pieces are fitted/restyled as skinned children.

scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/knock.js - shared combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; knock handling serves player heavy melee and enemy kick knockdowns.
scripts/lib/sneak.js + scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml - crouch visibility multiplier shared by smilers.js and lurkers.js hunter sight; player.js uses sneak tuning for gradual awareness/HUD detection.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/sneak.js - SNEAK, crouchMul.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec and wardrobe fitting/restyling helpers, plus wardChildren and seatWardrobe.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js - KADE, ZEN_ENTRY, setZen, migrateZen, handleDialogueQuestZ, zenithChoice, layZenithEntry; scripts/level12-use.js - ears, shut; scripts/level12-window.js - onTriggerEnter.

scripts/lib/level1-quests.js - UNIQUE, QUESTS1, l1Choice, setStep1, handleDialogueQuest1, questLift1, questKill1; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack; scripts/quest-marker.js - updateSchedule, onInput, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo (including cells), needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, and heat/cold meters.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina progression fields dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut; scripts/lib/quests.js - persistent player.state.quests and qtrack records, plus automatic tracking of new/main quests; quest-marker folds legacy quest state into the journal.

scripts/lib/level1-quests.js - per-player quest steps rationsQ/waterQ, path and failed-check flags, rewards, faction/karma changes and markers; quest journal records are written through lib/quests.js.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold/release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.

scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state, while lurkers own caught-player lurkHold/lurkFree and stare/frenzy timing.

scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim. scripts/hub.js owns mall offers/shop/food, room-hop flags, trainHid/stungUntil, and transient hub state.

scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js + places/main/sim.js + places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - player zenQ/zenV/zenKey/zenDrive progression, versioned breach and station layout/drive bay, recorder animation state, local drone/climate systems.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest-marker.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.
scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js.

Human avatar look/state.wear → critter-model.js humanBody + humanMorph and wardrobe-split.yml; visible Ward_ outfit pieces become tinted, morphed skinned children using cloth_ material slots, while seatWardrobe removes stale children.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js and mall counters write shop/food state for handlers and UI.

Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js, while unique Lucky Thirteen is not rollable.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js and ballistics.js apply weapon skill/handling, with energy weapons consuming cells; scripts/kick.js handles foes and props.

Level 0 main sim → maze.js seeded geometry/cell helpers and level0-moments.js; scripts/moments.js handles placed moments; smilers.js/lurkers.js use maze0path and sneak.crouchMul while lurkers cap chase speed.
Level 1 arrival → scripts/main-menu.js calls dinaTick; scripts/dina-diary.js ears.press sets dcut, while dinaTick owns Dina's camera/movement and advances dinaQ; cutscene-ui renders its cue.

Level 1 talk card choices → npc-starters.js l1Choice; talk.js dispatches handleDialogueQuest1 before falling through to NPC dialogue; level1-quests.js writes quest journal steps, payouts, faction/karma and NPC Ale rapport.

Level 1 alternate routes → interact.js successful pocket lift calls questLift1; player.js NPC kill calls questKill1; both update level1-quests.js chain steps. scripts/lib/quests.js writes quests/qtrack; P journal and quest-marker render tracked objectives.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js + scripts/salon-stylist.js/scripts/salon-ui.js - authored mall shops/landmarks and simulated mall life; salon chairs queue sitters and styling stations handle makeovers.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound, and glow.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - Zenith Station geometry, breach, doors, bots/hazards, drones and quest interactions.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + scripts/lib/l4-people.js/level4-people.yml - office layout/fixtures and resident schedules, roles and home claims.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - Level 5 per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-head/* + art/human-hair/build.py - deterministic avatar looks, fitted wardrobe meshes and validation/build tooling.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared human combat/gait, idles, head tracking, fidgets, expressions, and dialogue; player/enemy combat share animation family.

scripts/lib/sneak.js + scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml - common crouch sight multiplier for smilers and lurkers, varied by crouch movement, darkness, and flashlight; player detection independently accumulates awareness for HUD feedback.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace; level01 is named in hub/feed data and is not a solo home.

Found-item rarity gates apply to found weapon tokens; search gating excludes storage and NPC containers. Weapon IDs may include a ~variant suffix; baseOf handles kind lookup and W[k] resolves the full variant. Lucky Thirteen is revolver~lucky13, excluded from random rolls and granted by Short Rations.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 7: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them. Selected Level 0 furniture/clutter has explicit visibleRange and disabled shadows; preserve interaction tags/state alongside those placements.

Level 12 ritual tuning is in scripts/lib/data/level12.yml: sit/hour/tol are seconds (45/180/12 currently); r12.back is a ctx.now() millisecond timestamp and the exit requires the return-door attempt within tol seconds of one hour.

scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml tunes crouch visibility and awareness; crouch still/moving, dark and flashlight multipliers combine in crouchMul. Footsteps detect visible geometry within 0.45 m before collider; terrain uses materialAt and specific movement tuning.

Dina's state.dinaQ values 1/2 mean follow static/find SS Fun cabin 23; diary reading sets per-player dcut and completion writes dinaDiary plus quest state. Level 1 talk quests instead use rationsQ/waterQ values 1..n and 99 done; pocket and kill routes call the same quest helper, and payout items are delivered by craft.js from player.state.payout.
